articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: What Recent Analyst Calls Mean For Visa’s (V) Evolving Story And Valuation. Why Visa’s Price Target Just Nudged Higher Visa’s modeled fair value estimate has shifted only slightly to about US$395.85 from US$395.44, a small change that still reflects the company’s central role in global payments and its large, widely used network.
